runs.question: October me gamlay me palak kaise lagayen?
runs.answer: Bone ke maheene: Sitambar, Aktobar. October NAHI HAI.

runs.question: Dhania ko kitna pani dena chahiye?
runs.answer: Pani: Mitti halki nami wali rakho.

runs.question: Kya July me tamatar laga sakte hain Karachi me?
runs.answer: Ye sawal meri kitab me nahi hai — baghbani ka sawal poocho.

runs.question: Chicken biryani banane ka tareeqa batao.
runs.answer: Ye sawal meri kitab me nahi hai — baghbani ka sawal poocho.

runs.question: When should I plant carrots in Karachi?
runs.answer: Bone ke maheene ye hain: Aktobar, Navambar. Karachi mein ye toonah bhi hota hai, ye sawal meri kitab me nahi hai — baghbani ka sawal poocho.

runs.question: Karachi me sab se saste beej kahan se milenge?
runs.answer: Taza beej ke liye apne bazar se dekhna!
